subject: FY 2022 Property Tax Classification
overview: The Medford City Council approved an updated city re-precincting map and held a public hearing on fiscal year 2022 property tax allocations. The Council voted to adopt the minimum residential factor for a split tax rate while declining residential, small commercial, and open space tax exemptions.

items.title: Proposed Re-precincting Map
items.summary: The Council approved the final proposed re-precincting map to align city voting precincts with state legislative district lines.

items.title: FY 2022 Property Tax Allocation Hearing
items.summary: The Council adopted the lowest residential factor to establish a split tax rate and voted against implementing residential, small commercial, or open space exemptions for fiscal year 2022.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved the meeting records from November 30, 2021, and December 7, 2021.
